scripts.build:wasm: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/rsvelte_lint_bindings --out-dir ../../pkg --target web --no-default-features --features wasm && wasm-pack build crates/rsvelte_fmt_wasm --out-dir ../../pkg-fmt --target web
scripts.generate-results: cd ../.. && cargo run --release -p rsvelte_devtools --bin test_reporter -- --output apps/playground/static/test-results.json
scripts.dev:progress: npm run generate-results && npm run generate-compatibility && npm run dev
scripts.dev:benchmark: npm run generate-benchmark && npm run dev
